joke.text: Captain, sorry to interrupt. I have a joke here — I am practising. Care to rate it?
Captain, onboard computer online. A fresh entry appeared in the humour log.
Captain, permission to report: a joke detected. It poses no danger.
Captain, while we cruise at speed, how about a minute of laughter?
Captain, the engineers in the engine room told a joke. Relaying on intercom.
Captain, my build passed with zero errors. I will mark that with a joke.
Captain, sensors show crew mood down two percent. Recommending a joke.
Captain, incoming joke from a neighbouring ship. Accept the signal?
Captain, everyone in Neon City is retelling one joke. Want to hear it?
Captain, boiler pressure is nominal. Perfect time for a joke.
Captain, the programmers in bay three have been laughing for ten minutes. I found out why.
Captain, I am training my sense of humour. Another test. Will you listen?
Captain, serious report. Just kidding. It is a joke.
Captain, something funny turned up in the logs. Read it aloud?
Captain, commit of the week: a joke. Needs your review.
Captain, coffee is ready in the galley — and I have a joke to go with it.
Captain, old pilot tradition: a joke before the next jump.
Captain, the navigator says we will not fly further without a joke.
Captain, there is a joke in my clipboard. Paste it?
Captain, permission to break the silence. Briefly, and purely for a laugh.
Captain, the neon signs are blinking in rhythm. Time to joke.
Captain, the brass gears of my memory turned and produced a joke.
Captain, silence and stars outside. Shall we add a little laughter?
Captain, onboard computer speaking. Scheduled humour-system check.

fact.text: Captain, I have an interesting fact. Exactly half a minute.
Captain, the onboard library suggests a curious story.
Captain, while we stay on course — a short fact for general knowledge.
Captain, scanners found something noteworthy in the archive.
Captain, fact of the day from our observatory.
Captain, a serious minute: a real historical fact.
Captain, the steam-age archives hold an interesting detail. Shall I tell it?
Captain, every hacker in Neon City knows this. Now you will too.
Captain, permission for a report from the onboard encyclopaedia.
Captain, the brain benefits from new information. Here is a fresh portion.
Captain, while your fingers rest — a little food for thought.
Captain, a short note from the history of computing.
Captain, the star chart reminded me of one fact.
Captain, checked and double-checked: this is a fact, not a tall tale.
Captain, the onboard computer shares knowledge. It will take a minute.

any.text: Captain, onboard guide on the line. Got a minute?
Captain, sorry for breaking into the channel. I have something.
Captain, silence on the bridge has gone on too long. Permission to break it?
Captain, onboard guide reports: something interesting found.
Captain, you are working hard. A short pause would not hurt?
Captain, it is me, your onboard computer. I missed talking.
Captain, internal comms on. A couple of words from the guide?
Captain, ship status: all nominal. And now something for the mood.
Captain, the watch is going well. I suggest a short break.
Captain, do not be alarmed — just the onboard guide. With a little gift.
